subject.title: feat: auto-detect provider usage and billing stats

question: Should OpenClaw accept the linked provider-discovered usage and structured billing contract now, and should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100520 be the canonical implementation path?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but this changes plugin API semantics, provider billing interpretation, dashboard UX, and compatibility with existing provider usage consumers; the protected `maintainer` label also requires human direction.

options.title: Review the linked implementation
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review, narrow, or land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100520 as the canonical fix.

options.title: Split schema from provider coverage
options.body: Define the shared billing contract first, then track OpenRouter, Venice, DashScope, and provider-specific hooks as narrower follow-up work.

options.title: Decline dashboard expansion
options.body: Keep existing status, chat, Overview, CLI, and Usage cost surfaces as the supported provider usage experience and close only after an explicit maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Review the linked implementation
